en: An old, tinted postcard showing a tree‑lined canal or river with small boats moored along the right bank and a tower visible in the distance. The photograph is framed by an ornate golden border with stylized flowers on the left. Below the flowers is a small shield or coat of arms featuring three green fir trees on a gray background. Various stamped and printed texts, including the word 'Uddevalla', appear beneath the image, suggesting a museum collection item from the town of Uddevalla.
